# SI001 — missing-or-unpinned-sdk-header

Contract must start with a pinned py-genlayer dependency header.

## Why

An unpinned SDK lets validator behavior change between runs and makes the deployed source non-reproducible.

## Bad

```python
# Depends: "py-genlayer:latest"
class SafetyNet(gl.Contract): ...
```

## Good

```python
# { "Depends": "py-genlayer:<exact-hash>" }
class SafetyNet(gl.Contract): ...
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI001 -- reason
```
